Shape only their centerline paths; no swelling, brush contrast, taper, pointed ends, roughness, texture, serifs, shadows or decoration. Roundcaps and smoothly rounded joins; controlled curves, generous open channels and counters. Preserve exact stroke inventory, meaningful short/long bar relationships, detachments and attachments.

U+3D051 reading aid:
1. Left ritual: detached upper dash distinctly shorter than lower crossbar (roughly3/4); center long leg attached to crossbar, two flank legs detached.
2. Upper-right group: upright with short upper right hooked arm; a longer horizontal crossbar below, ending farther right than upper hook.

5. Each lower hand has a long outer curved C-like sweep with an inward lower tip, crossed by one shorter inward-pointing diagonal course that continues down as ONE long leg. Thus exactly TWO long bottom legs in right group.
6. Keep hand openings and central space clear; do not close them into boxed counters, add legs, or connect lower hands to the separate upper spreading branches.
